verdict.rationale: Groq maintains an official TypeScript SDK (groq-typescript) with concrete usage examples (audio transcription, file uploads) and extensive first-party docs covering chat completions, streaming, tool use, structured outputs, and OpenAI-compatible client usage, all of which are core to building against official SDKs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an official Python SDK repo (only OpenAI-compatible base_url swap is shown for Python) and independent/community validation specifically of SDK reliability rather than general API performance.
